definitions.gloss: genuine; authentic; official (of products or parts)
definitions.explanation: Describes products made by the original manufacturer, as opposed to third-party or counterfeit items.
Describes something that is free from impurities or foreign elements.

notes:
Most commonly encountered in consumer contexts (sense 1) when discussing whether a product is the original manufacturer's or a third-party alternative. Functions as a ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧-adjective when modifying nouns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {純正|じゅんせい}⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: genuine product/part
- {純正|じゅんせい}⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧: genuine parts
- {純正|じゅんせい}⟦アクセサリー→アクセサリー：01761_akusesarii⟧: official accessories
- {純正|じゅんせい}{律|りつ}: just intonation (music)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{正規|せいき}→正規：03776_seiki⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: authorized product (focuses on the sales channel)
- ⟦{純粋|じゅんすい}→純粋：08673_junsui⟧な: pure (more for abstract purity — feelings, intentions)
- ⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧: the real thing (more colloquial)
